The user asked on 2026-11-20 "Lets work on a1+ Unit 6 same all deal as before none stop all approved" (A1+ 6.Y follows A1 6.Y, one step each; fifteen lessons; the Units 2-4 deal: straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview). Four new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash): a bakery and a bookstore each in a corner building at a crossroads, and a police station and a gas station each across a street from a small park.

lesson.title: 6.6 The bakery is on the corner
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.lesson_title: The bakery is on the corner
lesson.sub_lesson_title: The bakery is on the corner
lesson.goal: Say where a place is with on the corner and opposite (The bakery is on the corner. The police station is opposite the park.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.6 Finding Places in the Neighborhood: A1 locates places with near, far from, between and across from; A1+ 6.6 adds on the corner and opposite. Each photo shows one place from 6.1 either in a corner building where two streets meet, with a crosswalk on each side, or across one street from a small park, seen from the park, so the photo tells on the corner from opposite the park.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.6 across from; A1+ 6.1 bakery, bookstore, police station, gas station; A1+ 4.1 Where's…?.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Stress the CORN-er and OP-po-site. Do not require native-like speed.
